meaning: strong drink, intoxicating drink, fermented or intoxicating liquor

renderings.kjv: place shalt thou cause the strong wine

elsewhere.note: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout…
he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of…
You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you.…
Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;
Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
